name: AMR Autonomous Mobile Robot — Hardened & Tuned QNX 8.0 Baseline

description: Properly engineered QNX 8.0 SMP robotics stack: /dev/lidar_fusion uses default ChannelCreate(0) so motion_planner (prio 52) boosts lidar_fusion from prio 18 -> 52 automatically during MsgSend/MsgReply, preventing fleet_telemetry (prio 28) preemption.
